answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like pearl, juniper, pigment, and every agent must answer a task keyed to them before its identity counts that round. Work cannot be precomputed, since templates for past words are worthless once new words drop, so one operator running thousands of fake agents must actually solve fresh, unpredictable tasks for every identity every epoch. Sybil cost thus scales linearly with fake accounts, mirroring real proof-of-personhood economics without any central ID registry.
